title: Centralized Structured Logging & Correlation IDs
learningObjectives: Emit JSON logs with standardized keys: timestamp, level, reqId, err, and service
Propagate correlation IDs through all downstream network calls and async jobs
Redact sensitive credentials, auth headers, and PII automatically in log serializers
keyTradeoffs: Synchronous console logging vs asynchronous buffered batch log shipping (Pino/Winston)
Verbose debug logging cost vs production diagnostic visibility
commonPitfalls: Logging raw request bodies containing plaintext passphrases or unmasked credit card numbers
Emitting unstructured multi-line text strings that break automated log parsers
transferPrompt: How are structured log metrics aggregated to calculate service error rates and alert on outages?
